besluite.fout: Right after 'Ander mense', 'hulle' first reads as people rather than the clothes it refers to.
besluite.rede: 'dit' is the natural Afrikaans pronoun for clothes here, points clearly back to 'tradisionele klere', and adds no words or meaning.

besluite.fout: The relative clause is ambiguous: 'wat' can be read as the language recognising the laws and government.

besluite.fout: 'baie van dieselfde ... deel' is a mild calque of English 'share many of the same'.
besluite.rede: This is a glossary definition, so only the writer may reword it; the writer should also note that 'deel' echoes the 'kultuur' definition.
